sources.title: Teacher · gate 2
sources.what: The RL teacher's 50 fresh-scene runs that decided the gate. Each run's path was re-run with physics and judged by SANT.

sources.title: Teacher · replay check
sources.what: 32 more runs on seeds outside the gate, to check that SANT's physics replay agrees with the teacher's own episodes.

sources.title: Distillation · round 0
sources.what: The teacher driving round 0 of the distillation, with cameras on. The verified runs became the camera robot's training data.
